# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About Nailflix
An online course selling platform focused on delivering digital education and training programs to students via the web. The business model revolves around creating, marketing, and selling online courses.

## Target Audience
- מקצועני מניקוריסטים
- חובבי יופי
- מחליפי קריירה

## Industry
Online Education
